Oh crud. Where we live in you don't have to get "building permits. Yesterday, I found out that you are supposed to self-report to the county auditor (tax dept) any "improvements" over $2000 within 60 days of starting or they hit you hard when they do the property reevaluations or, if they find out about it, and our Republican county is big on hitting people hard. I am self-reporting today to reduce any penalties, if any. "Upon the discovery of a building or improvement that has been constructed but of which the county auditor has not been notified as required by this section, the county auditor shall appraise it and place it upon the tax list and duplicate at its taxable value, together with a penalty equal to fifty per cent of the amount of taxes that would have been charged against the building or improvement from the date of construction to the date of discovery had the county auditor been notified of its construction as required by this section." If we end up in tax court, everybody on the fediverse knows we started our improvements with the intent of replacing the flat roof, , (which should be exempt from reporting) then at some point, decided to turn the carport into a health room after the bad winter prevented Penny from going to elective cardiac rehab like she did three times per week for over a year after her heart attack. :ohio2: Section 5713.17 | Duty to notify county auditor of improvement costing over $2,000 - penalty - examination of buildings. Rant: I'm very disappointed. I can't find anyone to hire or bid even on doing some work around the house that I need done. The locals ones make appointments to come out and then this or than comes up and they never make it. It's not price dickering. They aren't even showing up to make an estimate. So far, everything we have had done has been around market rates. We're 60 miles or so east of , 25 miles from far out burbs. I checked out job boards, too, looked for minority, lavender, and LGBTQ businesses that do home repair, building, handy person work, etc and there are no listings near me. I've contacted Craigslist posters, everything. People keep saying, "Oh, you have to go on Facebook and post something..." UGH. I want to get some of this done before tariffs makes the price even more expensive, damnit. I'm to the point now where, if you have framing skills, some electrical, plumbing and roofing, etc skills and want to make some real money over a couple week period, bring your travel trailer and get to work. Everything we need done can be wrapped up in two weeks if a person worked 6 or so hours every worked day. Not too labor intensive, either. Just a few of the jobs off the top of my head: *25 electrical receptacles replaced. (Wire is good, it's the crappy recalled 1990s outlets) *Replace metal waterline that is exposed in the basement, so not hard to do, with copper or PVC (around 35 feet) *Add a couple outdoor water spigots *Build deck with 8x10 shingled overhang *replace and frame old "Florida" style windows for traditional windows *install basement interior door *take small 14x18 flat roof and frame and shingle it pitched. *remove non-load bearing closet
